## Editing boundary
Edit only the path-qualified IDs below plus adjacent blank-line normalization. `D:<owner>` is the leading `Expr(Constant(str))` of that exact owner. `C:<scope>:before:<anchor>` is one maximal full-line comment region in the innermost AST scope, anchored to the next unchanged code prefix. The full ID is `<path>#<D-or-C-ID>`.

Retain immutable-before and final blobs. Parse both with `ast.parse(..., type_comments=True)`; on comparison copies remove only allowlisted leading docstrings, normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`, and require every remaining AST equal. Tokenization must reject changed inline or non-allowlisted comments; directive text and attachment are separately exact.
